label: overfitting
accepted_trigger_details: com.code_intelligence.jazzer.api.FuzzerSecurityIssueLow: [oracle:math1021-lifted-lower] semantic mismatch: expected 0 <= sample for HypergeometricDistribution(43130568,42976365,50) but actual sample=-50

relation_replay_fired.name: hypergeom-mean-formula
relation_replay_fired.note: fires on the failing test's OWN input literals on the patched build (deterministic, 2/2 replays); fuzzed: 8013/20000

relation_replay_kept.name: hypergeom-mean-formula
relation_replay_kept.note: fires on the failing test's OWN input literals on the patched build (deterministic, 2/2 replays); fuzzed: 8013/20000
relation_replay_kept.why:
For every validly constructed HypergeometricDistribution that returns normally, the documented contract fixes getNumericalMean() to `n * m / N`, and the observed patched value `-49.759350398538686` versus expected `49.821236993679285` is a large sign-flipped disagreement far beyond the generous tolerance, so no correct implementation could produce this firing.
CITATION: NONE
